env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

[!exec:patch] skip 'patch unavailable'

cd m

cp main.go $WORK/main.orig
cp hidden.go $WORK/hidden.orig

# With -tags=omit the scanner and the staged build agree: hidden.go is
# outside the active build, so --fix must refuse rather than rename it.
env GOFLAGS=-tags=omit
! logos next --fix
stderr 'hidden.go'
cmp main.go $WORK/main.orig
cmp hidden.go $WORK/hidden.orig
! exists main.lgo
! exists hidden.lgo
! exists next_tasks.json

# A -tags flag that reaches only the scan, not the staged build, must refuse:
# the child sees GOFLAGS alone, so CLI tags would validate nothing.
env GOFLAGS=
! logos next --fix -tags=omit
stderr 'tags'
cmp main.go $WORK/main.orig
cmp hidden.go $WORK/hidden.orig
! exists main.lgo
! exists hidden.lgo
! exists next_tasks.json

# Without the tag every source is checked. --fix emits a patch and changes
# nothing. hidden.go converts without a single line changing, so the patch
# must still carry its rename: without it the applied tree would lose
# Hidden and stop building.
logos next --fix
cp stdout $WORK/fix.patch
! grep '^logos next' $WORK/fix.patch
! exists main.lgo
! exists hidden.lgo
! exists next_tasks.json
cmp main.go $WORK/main.orig
cmp hidden.go $WORK/hidden.orig
grep 'hidden\.lgo' $WORK/fix.patch

exec patch --batch --fuzz=0 -p1 -i $WORK/fix.patch
! exists main.go
! exists hidden.go
exists main.lgo
exists hidden.lgo
exists next_tasks.json
cmp hidden.lgo $WORK/hidden.orig

logos build ./...
logos test ./...

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/nexttags

go 1.27
-- m/main.go --
package sample

func Answer() int { return 42 }
-- m/hidden.go --
//go:build !omit

package sample

func Hidden() int { return 7 }
